table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	dbo.quotationheader.quotationcode,   
	dbo.quotationheader.custcode,   
	dbo.quotationheader.salesmancode,   
	dbo.quotationheader.date,
	dbo.quotationheader.headerno,
	salesmanname = dbo.users.username,
	dbo.quotationheader.discperc,   
	dbo.quotationheader.flatdisc,   
	dbo.quotationheader.misccharges,  
	invGSTperc1 = dbo.quotationheader.invGSTperc1,   
	dbo.quotationheader.salestax,   
	dbo.quotationheader.postdate,   
	dbo.quotationheader.remarks,   
	dbo.quotationheader.originaldate,
	dbo.quotationheader.modifiedby,
	dbo.quotationheader.postedby,	
	dbo.quotationheader.ValidateUpTo,
	dbo.quotationheader.SPrice,
	custname='Counter Retail Sale Customer              ',
	dbo.quotationheader.posted,
	quotationheader.custrefno,
	quotationheader.remarks2,
	quotationheader.remarks3,
	quotationheader.remarks4,
	quotationheader.remarks5,
	quotationheader.remarks6,
	quotationheader.remarks7,
	quotationheader.remarks8,
	quotationheader.remarks9,
	loosepack=quotationheader.loosepack,
	quotationheader.pagesize,
	quotationheader.messagecode,
	quotationheader.Smancode,
	quotationheader.Active,
	quotationheader.Locked,
	quotationheader.AutoInsertNewItems,
	quotationheader.DeliveryDays,
	quotationheader.ValidityDays,
	quotationheader.PaymentTo
FROM 
	dbo.quotationheader,   
	dbo.users  
WHERE 
	( dbo.users.usercode = dbo.quotationheader.salesmancode ) and  
	( dbo.quotationheader.quotationcode = :ar_QuotationCode )
